# DataForSEO Business Listings Categories Aggregation API

Business category counts for a location or filter set, for local market sizing.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/business_data/business_listings/categories_aggregation/live` task schema (one task per call). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/business_data/business_listings/categories_aggregation/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"categories": ["pizza_restaurant"], "location_coordinate": "40.7128,-74.0060,10"}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint. Main fields:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `categories` | Optional array of category ids to aggregate. |
| `location_coordinate` | "latitude,longitude,radius_km". |
| `limit` | Maximum number of categories to return. |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/business_data/business_listings/categories_aggregation/live/

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.048 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or tokens a call returns. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
